name: Great-Great Grandma Barnes' Rhubarb Pie
author: Great-Great Grandma Barnes
steps: Line a 9-inch pie plate with the bottom pie crust.
Cut the rhubarb into bite-size pieces.
In a large bowl, mix together the rhubarb (cut into bite-size pieces), sugar, flour, and egg (beaten) until well combined.
Pour the filling into the prepared bottom crust.
Dot the top of the filling with small pieces of butter.
Place the top crust over the filling and seal the edges as desired.
Bake for 50-60 minutes, or until the crust is golden and the filling is bubbling.
Remove from the oven, let cool slightly, and serve.
